{{Top|leg}}
'''Snooper Goggles''' were a specialized version of [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]], attached to a headband that collected ambient light allowing the wearer to see in near darkness. Standard models lacked the long-range sight of macrobinoculars, while newer models included [[photoreducing sensor]]s to compensate for rapidly changing light levels.
